shorts_extract.hook: Zero conscious sight, >90% bullseye pointing: how Patient D.B. and Lawrence Weiskrantz discovered the brain's hidden second visual highway.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Weiskrantz et al. (1974 Brain / Lancet): forced-choice pointing & X-vs-O guessing without V1 via the superior colliculus bypass.
shorts_extract.twist: Patient T.N.'s obstacle-course hallway walk, 'Affective Blindsight' for unseen faces, and why thirsty blindsight patients still prove consciousness isn't useless.
